title: Scaffolder for Optimizely settings
description: Per-solution settings for the Scaffolder for Optimizely Visual Studio extension. Every value is optional; anything left out is detected from the project.

templateSource.description: Where file content comes from. 'dotnet-new' uses Optimizely's EPiServer.Templates where it has a matching template and falls back to the built-in templates; 'embedded' always uses the built-in templates. Per-solution overrides in .optimizely/templates/ win either way.

layout.description: 'conventional' puts models, controllers, components, view models and views in their own folders. 'feature' keeps everything next to the item. Leave out to detect from where existing views live.

fileScopedNamespaces.description: Use file-scoped namespaces. Leave out to match existing code.

folders.description: Folders (relative to the project) used by the conventional layout, and when scaffolding from the project node.

catalog.description: Commerce catalog content types (products, variations, bundles, packages, categories).

viewModels.description: Leave out to use the folder holding most existing *ViewModel classes, else a folder named ViewModels, else Models/ViewModels.

initialization.description: Initialization modules. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/Initialization.

startupFilters.description: IStartupFilter classes. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/Initialization.

scheduledJobs.description: Scheduled jobs. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/ScheduledJobs.

serviceExtensions.description: IServiceCollection extensions. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Extensions.

selectionFactories.description: Selection factories and queries. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/SelectionFactories.

editorDescriptors.description: Editor descriptors. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/EditorDescriptors.

visitorGroups.description: Visitor group criteria. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/VisitorGroups.

contentEvents.description: Content events handlers. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/ContentEvents.

validators.description: IValidate<T> validators. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/Validation.

catalogControllers.description: Controllers for Commerce catalog content. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else the controllers folder.

promotions.description: Commerce promotions and their processors. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/Promotions.

payments.description: Commerce payment gateways and payment methods. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/Payments.

shipping.description: Commerce shipping gateways. Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/Shipping.

orderServices.description: Commerce order service decorators (validators, calculators, price processors). Leave out to use where existing ones live, else Business/Orders.

baseClasses.description: Default base classes as full type names, e.g. 'MySite.Models.Pages.SitePageData'. Leave out to pick from abstract base classes found in the project.

contentTypeGroup.description: Default content type group expression, e.g. 'Globals.GroupNames.Content'.

viewPaths.description: Razor view path patterns relative to the project, where {name} is the content type's class name. Leave out to learn them from existing views (matched by @model), falling back to MVC's default locations.

passViewPath.description: Default for 'Pass view path to View()'. Leave out to pass it only when the view isn't where MVC looks by default and the project has no IViewLocationExpander.

companions.description: Default state of the companion-file checkboxes.
